001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.combat.threat;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEngineAPI;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.DamagingProjectileAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.OnFireEffectPlugin;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.WeaponAPI;
007
008public class NeutronTorpedoOnFireEffect implements OnFireEffectPlugin {
009        public static float VEL_MULT = 0.33f;
010        
011        public void onFire(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, WeaponAPI weapon, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
012                projectile.getVelocity().scale(VEL_MULT);
013        }
014}
